note: Copy this file to cost-limits.json to change the limits. enabled=false turns off the dollar caps per run and per day; costs are still written down. relay_max_wakes_per_day=0 means no limit on coordinator turns, whatever AI tool the coordinator is. The dollar caps apply to Claude Code turns only. relay_max_codex_wakes_per_day: how many planner turns the Codex wake may start a day (0 means no limit). relay_max_agent_wakes_per_day: how many times a day the relay may wake each agent for its mail (0 means no limit). relay_max_agent_turns_at_once: how many agents it may wake for mail at the same time (1 to 10). worker_runs_per_day: how many Codex, Gemini and Antigravity workers may start in one day, counted from the runs.md of each task (0 means no limit). relay_max_worker_starts_per_day: how many workers the relay may start a day for start requests (W<n>-start.md; 0 means no limit). gemini_max_session_turns: how many turns a Gemini worker, a Gemini CLI coordinator turn or a Gemini CLI agent turn may take (0 means no limit). Gemini CLI may skip the limit for a coordinator or an agent in a mailbox folder, so also set model.maxSessionTurns in your own Gemini settings. relay_max_new_agents_per_day: how many new agents the relay may make a day for agent requests (agents\<name>.md; 0 means no limit, at most 20). relay_max_agent_usd_per_day: the most dollars a day that Claude Code agent turns and new Claude Code agents may use (0 means no cap); a turn that could pass it waits, and its mail stays queued until tomorrow. agent_wakes_per_day: how many turns a day all agents of one AI tool may have in all, new agents' first turns included (gemini is 4 unless you change it; 0 means no limit). relay_max_mail_hops: how many turns in a row the relay may start for mail between agents with no person in between before it holds the mail as a possible loop (0 means no limit).
